title: Cragstone Middle Guard Camp
subtitle: Guruk Colossus spawns for Brogosh's kill task

notes.title: Colossus count and respawn
notes.body: 14 Colossi are placed here, each from a 5-minute generator, so you need about three passes for 30 kills. The Guruk generator near the boss end also spawns random Guruks every 30 seconds, and Colossus is one of them.

notes.title: Best element
notes.body: Frost and piercing weapons do the most damage to Guruk Colossi (cold 70%, pierce 75%). Avoid acid (10%) and lightning (20%).

notes.title: Fumes and spores
notes.body: 98 Noxious Fumes clouds (30 pierce damage every 2 seconds) and some Spores (20 damage a second) cover the corridors. They hurt but you can walk through.

notes.title: Morgluuk bosses
notes.body: Two level 200 Morgluuks spawn at the bottom near the Portal to Burun Fortress (15 minutes between respawns). The portal leads out of the camp.
